text: The district procurement bulletin for week 1: District stores report that relief demand is running above the seasonal norm. The district health office has asked manufacturers to keep institutional buyers supplied through the relief period.
Week 1, Kaveri Healthcare: filed ₹1,200 a carton, sold 9 cartons for ₹10,800 revenue and ₹3,267 profit.
